goal: Tell whether a PrismLegal matter node is current, so a strategy only ever rests on reviewed, grounded and up-to-date support.

app.name: matter-support
limits: It does not detect citation or dependency cycles; Matter::current excludes them.
It does not decide what a passage means; review does.
app.title: Current support
app.purpose: Decide whether a fact or conclusion in a matter is current, pending review, or withheld, from its origin, whether it was accepted, how many citations or dependencies ground it and how many of those are no longer current.

fields.name: grounds
fields.means: citations of an extracted node, or dependencies of an inferred one

fields.name: stale
fields.means: of its citations and dependencies, those no longer current

meanings.current: the node is admitted and may support strategies
meanings.pending: review has not accepted it, so it supports nothing
meanings.withheld: it lacks grounding or current support, so it supports nothing

rules.why: src/Matter.lex.tex ready: a node counts only once accepted (MatterLaws unreviewedSupportCannotAuthorizeInference)
src/Matter.lex.tex grounded: an extracted node needs a citation
src/Matter.lex.tex grounded: an inferred node needs dependencies
src/Matter.lex.tex citationsCurrent and allReferencesIn: a changed source or a corrected dependency invalidates it (correctionInvalidatesImmediateDependent, missingSupportIsNotCurrent)

app.otherwiseWhy: src/Matter.lex.tex ready: accepted, grounded, every citation current and every dependency admitted

properties.why: unreviewed support cannot authorize an inference
a correction invalidates every dependent, immediate or transitive
a reviewed, accepted node with current support is admitted

stakeholders.name: Lawyer
stakeholders.text: Builds strategies on a matter and needs every fact they rest on to be reviewed and current.

stakeholders.name: Client
stakeholders.text: Brings a matter and needs a correction to reach every conclusion that depended on the old wording.

concerns.name: Corrections propagate
concerns.text: A corrected or withdrawn source invalidates every dependent conclusion, immediate or transitive, while unrelated context stays.

components.name: Matter file
components.text: The saved matter file, which replays the complete accepted command history, up to 2,048 commands.

components.name: Imported resources
components.text: The UTF-8 text and CSV resources a client or lawyer imports, whose passages and cells are cited.

threats.name: Unreviewed extraction promoted
threats.text: A passage the system extracted is used as a fact before anyone reviewed it.

control.name: Acceptance required
control.text: An unaccepted node is never current, proved for every request.

threats.name: Stale source after replacement
threats.text: A resource is replaced and a conclusion keeps citing its old wording.

control.name: Invalidation proved
control.text: Any stale citation or dependency withholds the node, proved for every request.

threats.name: Self-supporting inference
threats.text: A conclusion is grounded only on itself or on a cycle of conclusions.
threats.accepted: The app takes the counts it is given; cycles are excluded upstream by Matter::current, whose fixed point admits no self or mutual cycle (selfCycleIsNotEvidence, mutualCycleIsNotEvidence).

quality.text: No node with a stale citation or dependency is answered current.
quality.measureText: Requests with stale at least 1 answered current.
